hook.text: You said “sorry” 12 times at work today. Allah? Not once.

verses.text: “Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers.”

end.text: You said “sorry” 12 times at work today. Allah? Not once.
end.gold: Tonight, before you sleep: Astaghfirullah. 12 times.

captions: To the client. The foreman. The driver you kept waiting.
5:10 p.m. The crane swings the last load of the day.
The concrete is late again. Your phone buzzes: “Unacceptable.”
“Sorry. I'm so sorry. It won't happen again.” Number twelve.
Then, above the scaffolding, a minaret catches the last light.
And you wonder: when did I last say sorry to Him?
The walk home. The river, slow and quiet.
You stop. Gloves in your pocket. Dust still on your hands.
Twelve times. Softer each time. Lighter each time.

post.caption:
You said “sorry” 12 times at work today. Allah? Not once. 🏗️

To the client, the foreman, the driver. Then a minaret caught the last light above the scaffolding — and you wondered when you last said sorry to Him.

“Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.” (71:10)

Tonight, before you sleep: Astaghfirullah. 12 times.
